description: Create a new reusable background scene for the workspace, such as the dealer's own showroom, a branded studio or a specific outdoor setting. Use it when none of the scenes in list_backgrounds fits; it does not edit a car photo (that is generate_background), and to adjust a custom background that already exists use refine_background instead of creating another. Give a `description`, `reference_image_urls`, or both; add `base_background_id` to start from a built-in scene and describe only what to change. Renders a preview with a demo car and returns it as an image plus the new background's `id`, ready to pass to generate_background. Costs one credit; a rejected or failed request is not charged.

base_background_id.description: A built-in background `id` to start from; the description then says what to change.

description.description: The scene: walls, floor, lighting, setting. E.g. 'A bright showroom with light oak flooring and floor-to-ceiling windows'.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to three public image URLs of the place or style to recreate.

name: create_background
title: Create custom background
